# Assay README Template

## Assay Title

Thyroid hormone uptake assay

## Assay Description
Thyroid hormone transport experiments were performed in a 24-well plate. 
Cells were incubated for the indicated timepoints at 37°C and 5% CO2 in Dulbecco’s Phosphate Buffered Saline (DPBS) (Gibco, Thermofisher Life Technologies Europe, UK) supplemented with 0.1% D-Glucose (CAS 50-99-7, Merck, Germany), 1 nM T3 or T4, and 5 × 104 counts/min (cpm) [125I]T3 or [125I]T4. 
For EDC testing, compounds were added to the incubation medium at the indicated concentrations and cells were incubated for 10 minutes. 
After exposure, cells were rinsed with DPBS with 0.1% D-Glucose and 0.1% bovine serum albumin (BSA) (CAS 9048-46-8, Sigma-Aldrich, Merck, Germany) and lysed in 0.5 mL 0.1M NaOH. 
Radioactivity in the cell lysates was measured using a γ-counter (PerkinElmer Wizard2® 2470 automatic gamma counter, USA). 
Thyroid hormone uptake assays were performed in three independent assays in duplicate for both time-dependence and for the effects of EDCs. 

To characterize thyroid hormone transport in the cell lines, we first measured time-dependent T3 and T4 uptake  

Reference compounds silychristin and lesinurad were used to test whether thyroid hormone transport could be inhibited in these cell lines. 
Silychrsitin is a known MCT8 inhibitor (Johannes, Jayarama-Naidu et al. 2016) and lesinurad an inhibitor of several organic anion transporters (OATs) that can also transport thyroid hormone as well as the  T4 transporter OATP1C1 

We also tested we tested reference compounds for metabolism and receptor activation and endocrine disruption chemicals for their effect on T3 and T4 uptake in the cell models. 

Reference compounds tested: sulfobromophthalein, cefuroxime, chlorpyrifos, mono-butyl phthalate, Polybrominated diphenyl ethers-99, Tetrabromobisphenol A
EDCs tested: Amiodarone, iopanoic acid, lesinurad, NH-3, silychristin, xanthohumol

## File Organization
[Briefly explain how do the files in the folder relate to eachother]

The paper has two parts: characterisation of thyroid hormone uptake of three cell lines (H4, MO3.13, SK-N-AS) and testing reference compounds of EDCs. 
assay1_characterisation uptake: processed and raw data files of characterisation of three cell lines
assay1_EDCs: processed and raw data files of endocrine disrupting chemicals tested in the assay
